title: praktor Telegram uploads can overwrite persistent agent instructions
summary: A Telegram document filename can escape the uploads directory and overwrite files in the persistent agent workspace. This can plant instructions or execution configuration consumed by later agent runs.

severity.rationale: Remote file writes reach persistent agent instructions. Messaging the bot is sufficient with the default unrestricted sender policy, making unattended agents especially exposed.

exposure: Exposed when untrusted Telegram users can send documents to the bot; an empty sender allowlist permits everyone.

remediation.details: Upgrade to 0.9.1. Until then, restrict telegram.allow_from to trusted sender IDs.
remediation.risk: Low. Test dependent workflows after updating.

verification: Confirm the installed version or revision and exercise the affected workflow with trusted inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
